value.rationale: Sparse-site stochastic dynamics pose the physically motivated problem of how many and where local noise channels are needed to erase initial-condition information. The theorem gives minimal two-site forcing, an exact arithmetic placement criterion, a sharp information-theoretically optimal finite-time threshold, and a complete noncoprime deficiency law for every finite ring. These facts are nontrivial structural invariants, not isolated checks.
